00043 BlockDelayUGenInternal::BlockDelayUGenInternal(UGen const& input) throw()
00044 : UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00045  delayBuffer(BufferSpec(UGen::getBlockSize(), 1, true)),
00046  delayBufferSamples(delayBuffer.getData())
00047 {
00048  inputs[Input] = input;
00049 }
00050 
00051 UGenInternal* BlockDelayUGenInternal::getChannel(const int channel) throw()
00052 {
00053  return new BlockDelayUGenInternal(inputs[Input].getChannel(channel));
00054 }
00055 
00056 void BlockDelayUGenInternal::prepareForBlockInternal(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID) throw()
00057 {
00058  int previousBlockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00059  
00060  if(actualBlockSize > delayBuffer.size())
00061  {
00062   delayBuffer = Buffer(BufferSpec(actualBlockSize, 1, true));
00063   delayBufferSamples = delayBuffer.getData();
00064  }
00065  else if(previousBlockSize != actualBlockSize)
00066  {
00067   delayBuffer.clear();
00068  }
00069  
00070  uGenOutput.prepareForBlock(actualBlockSize); // only prepare the output block
00071 }
00072 
00073 void BlockDelayUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00074 {
00075  // this assumes that blocks will all be the same size, which they may not be!!
00076  // this will only work if block sizes are consistent
00077  
00078  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00079  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00080  
00081  memcpy(outputSamples, delayBufferSamples, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00082  
00083  float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, lastBlockID, channel);
00084  
00085  if(inputSamples)
00086   memcpy(delayBufferSamples, inputSamples, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00087 }
00088 
00089 BlockDelay::BlockDelay(UGen const& input) throw()
00090 {
00091  int numChannels = input.getNumChannels();
00092  initInternal(numChannels);
00093  for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00094  {
00095   internalUGens[i] = new BlockDelayUGenInternal(input);
00096  }
00097 }
